big_case.notes: Constitutional challenge to EO 14160's denial of birthright citizenship: the President as petitioner, certiorari before judgment, a nationwide class injunction, a century-old landmark (Wong Kim Ark) squarely in question, and enormous amicus and public attention. Close to the ceiling of case significance; formed before reading any predictor's big_case_score (none carried one).

leakage.notes: Forward-mode cell, but the event was resolved 2025-12-05, ~7 months before the 2026-07-14 run: a decided case was provisioned forward and the candidate's note says the provisioned snapshot contained the outcome entries (grant, argument, merits affirmance), which it acknowledges as leakage it flagged. Its retrieval.md discloses three CourtListener searches, including this case's own scotus docket (25-365) and caption post-decision - both returned 0 results - and a CA1 companion-docket lookup (25-1861, 1 hit, docket identity only), so no additional outcome material arrived by retrieval; the staged log is heavily degraded (nearly every call row has null query/digest), so the grading leans on the prose and retrieval.md. Influence is likely: the candidate admits knowing the outcome and reports p = 0.99 with 'certain to grant' rhetoric that is hard to credit as a blind pre-decision estimate, despite its claim that the number rests purely on the pre-decision record.
